mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently eighty degrees and sunny, though it feels closer to eighty-four degrees down by the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight offers excellent star-gazing, featuring a beautiful waxing crescent moon and a visible pass of the International Space Station starting at nine thirty-one PM in the northwest sky.

In city news, Verona is making green living easier for everyone. Residents in apartments can take advantage of the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue for food waste drop-off. Additionally, the city continues to promote sustainability by installing anti-idling tech in new ambulances, transitioning streetlights to energy-efficient LEDs, and offering rebates for rain barrels and low-flow toilets.

There are several exciting local events approaching. On July nineteenth, you can enjoy the Mount Horeb Art Fair or live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie. Looking slightly further ahead, make sure to mark your calendar for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, happening on Wednesday, July twenty-second at Hometown Junction Park.

In the weekly police report, on Friday, July tenth, the Verona Police Department's canine unit, K9 Drea, successfully assisted with two separate evening traffic stops. During both stops, K9 Drea alerted officers to the presence of drugs, resulting in citations for driving with suspended licenses and drug possession.

Wrap up your day with a trip to Culver's for today's delicious flavor of the day, Turtle, featuring creamy vanilla custard with hot fudge, hot caramel, and toasted pecans. They are open until ten PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to head over. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
